verdict.rationale: Missive's docs describe canned responses (templates) that you write once, insert with a few keystrokes, and share with a team or company. A variables templating engine adds dynamic content such as the recipient's name, and the changelog confirms {{ user.name }}/{{ user.email }} variables resolve consistently. Missing for 10: any evidence that templates can carry attachments, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the template workflow.
